segments.title: 第112章 摸摸腹肌
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 112: Touching the Abs

The three girls Li Luo knew all had long hair.

Ying Chanxi's long hair was shoulder-length, with the ends resting perfectly on her shoulders, giving her a very student-like air.

Especially when she tied her hair up in a high ponytail, the end of the short ponytail would stick up at the back of her head, looking utterly adorable.

In comparison, Xu Youyu's hair was slightly longer, but only just past her shoulders.

Moreover, Xu Youyu's hair wasn't very thick, which might have been related to her habit of often staying up late.

This made her long hair look quite wispy, lifting at the slightest breeze.

Among the three, Yan Zhusheng's hair was the blackest, longest, and thickest. Not only was her hair long, but its quality was also excellent.

It seemed to be related to her healthy lifestyle and exercise habits.

When Yan Zhusheng let her hair down, the ends could reach almost to the small of her back.

Even when tied in a high ponytail, the ponytail would sway as she walked, gently tapping against her back.

And at this moment, Ying Chanxi pinched a long strand of hair.

Looking at its length, Ying Chanxi was certain it was neither hers nor Xu Youyu's.

So...

"When did Zhusheng come over to the house?"

"Hmm?" Li Luo was taken aback. He leaned in to look at the hair in Ying Chanxi's hand, then said with a laugh, "It's probably her hair."

"You went to school this afternoon for competition training, and I was making dinner here in the evening."

"Your older sister happened to come back in the afternoon and asked if she should invite Yan Zhusheng over for dinner. I said sure, so she called her over."

"After dinner, I went back to my room to play on the computer. Around six, Yan Zhusheng came in to get me."

"I told her to wait for me to finish my game, so she sat beside me and waited."

Hearing Li Luo's clear explanation, Ying Chanxi pressed her lips together, not knowing whether to be happy or angry.

Of course, she didn't really think there was anything going on between Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng.

But looking at the hair in her hand, Ying Chanxi took a deep breath and threw it into the trash can.

She then had Li Luo move the pillows and quilt off the bed, yanked off the bedsheet with both hands, and carried it to the bathroom to wash in the machine along with her own sheet.

After returning to Li Luo's bedroom, she took out the clean bedsheet and helped Li Luo make his bed, carefully tucking in the four corners.

"Done." Ying Chanxi clapped her hands, looking at the fresh bedsheet with a satisfied nod. Then she looked at Li Luo and asked, "Are you going to sleep?"

"I'm going to take a shower first." Li Luo pointed to the bathroom in his bedroom.

"Oh, go ahead then." Ying Chanxi nodded. "Is it okay if I use the computer for a bit?"

"Sure." Li Luo's expression was normal. He wasn't worried she would discover what he was writing, as he always kept all related software and webpages well hidden.

So Li Luo took his change of clothes and walked into the bathroom.

Ying Chanxi sat down at the computer. After turning it on, she listened to the sound of running water from the bathroom but didn't know what to do.

She wasn't in the habit of prying into others' privacy, so she didn't rummage through his computer and just logged into her QQ.

Unlike most people's QQ, the moment Ying Chanxi logged in, the friend request page turned bright red.

More than a dozen new friend request notifications popped up, almost all from boys at school.

Ying Chanxi helplessly rejected them one by one. Unless they were classmates or acquaintances from a club, she ignored them all.

Even so, her QQ friend list was filled with all sorts of boys who had added her out of admiration, which was a real headache.

Some of the bolder and more thick-skinned boys would often send her messages out of the blue.

Simple greetings were one thing, but some people were rather creepy and disgusting, asking very private questions.

When faced with such situations, Ying Chanxi could only ignore them directly; she couldn't even really block them.

If she blocked too many people, all sorts of private rumors might start to spread.

Although Ying Chanxi wasn't considered particularly aloof at school, that was the impression she gave those boys.

A message sent on QQ might not get a response for several days.

But they couldn't imagine that while they were only sending messages to Ying Chanxi, she had to deal with a great many more.

When the numbers piled up, this kind of thing became truly annoying.

Over time, Ying Chanxi stopped logging into QQ unless absolutely necessary. If she really needed to contact a classmate or friend, she would just call or text them directly.

Today was a rare occasion for her to log in, and right away, dozens of new messages were blinking.

Ying Chanxi glanced through them, directly deleting the chat windows of strangers as if she hadn't seen them.

For those she was more familiar with, she would reply politely.

Among them were classmates like Liu Shaowen and Xie Shuchen.

Liu Shaowen: I heard you like dolls, so I gave you one on Saturday. It's the little dinosaur. I hope you like it.

Ying Chanxi furrowed her brow, trying hard to recall, but she couldn't remember where Li Luo had put that little dinosaur.

But Ying Chanxi still replied with a "thank you."

Xie Shuchen: I'm on guitar duty in the rock club recently. We'll be performing at the opening and closing ceremonies of the sports meet.

Xie Shuchen: Sigh... several of the older students went to participate in competitions, so we almost couldn't get enough people for the band. Luckily, we have just enough now.

Xie Shuchen: But I've switched to playing the keyboard to fill a vacancy in the band. I hope we can gel smoothly.

Xie Shuchen: We also have to perform at the parent-teacher conference next week, in front of all the parents... I wonder if your mom or dad will come? I hope my performance won't disappoint them.

It felt like this guy was almost treating her QQ as his personal diary, leaving a message every few days.

Ying Chanxi didn't know what to say, so she could only reply, "Good luck with your practice," and then closed the chat window.

Sighing, Ying Chanxi idly opened her QQ Zone and browsed for a while. Then her gaze shifted and landed on Li Luo's bed.

Thinking of the strand of hair from before, Ying Chanxi didn't know what came over her. She inexplicably stood up, walked to the side of the bed, and sat down in the same spot Yan Zhusheng had sat in earlier.

After sitting for a moment, Ying Chanxi suddenly felt that what she was doing was a bit foolish. She quickly stood up again and returned to the desk.

When Li Luo finished his shower, changed his clothes, and walked out of the bathroom drying his hair, Ying Chanxi stood up and walked toward the living room, saying to him, "I'll go get the hairdryer, you sit down."

"Oh." Li Luo sat down in the chair and glanced at the computer screen. He then nodded in relief, confirming that Ying Chanxi probably hadn't found anything.

It seemed she had only logged into her QQ.

Li Luo glanced at Ying Chanxi's QQ profile picture and soon heard the patter of footsteps from outside the door.

Ying Chanxi walked in with the hairdryer. After plugging it in, she took the towel off his head and started to dry his hair for him.

Just then, Ying Chanxi's QQ avatar suddenly started flashing. Someone else was messaging her.

"Should I open it?" Li Luo held the mouse and asked.

"Take a look. If it's not someone I know, don't bother with it," Ying Chanxi answered casually.

So Li Luo clicked open the chat window.

The next second, a selfie of someone's abs appeared on the computer screen.

For a moment, both of them were stunned.

"Who is this guy?" Li Luo frowned and looked at the nickname, which had no real name noted. He then looked at the background of the abs photo, which seemed to be a school dorm bathroom. "So creepy. Why would he send a random photo like this."

"I don't know him." Ying Chanxi furrowed her brow and shook her head. "Delete it."

"Do people send you this kind of stuff often?" Li Luo asked curiously as he deleted it.

"Not often, but there are people like this occasionally." Ying Chanxi looked helpless. "That one was actually decent-looking. There are more disgusting ones."

"What's so decent about it?" Li Luo pouted. "Who doesn't have abs? I have them too."

"Really?" Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo, subconsciously looking toward the collar of his shirt.

"Where are you looking?" Li Luo covered his chest and looked at her suspiciously.

Ying Chanxi's pretty face flushed red from his gaze, and she swatted his head in annoyance. "As if I really want to see."

"It's not like you can't have a look."

"...I don't want to look, but I kind of don't believe you have abs."

"Here." Li Luo turned sideways and lifted the shirt on his stomach. With a swish, he immediately covered it back up. "See? I really do!"

"You covered it so quickly, what could I have seen?" Ying Chanxi put the hairdryer aside, speechless. "Let me check again."

"Hey, hey, hey, keep your hands to yourself!"

After messing around for a bit, Ying Chanxi ran off with the hairdryer.

After putting the hairdryer away and returning to her own bedroom, Ying Chanxi's face, which had turned beet red, gradually returned to normal.

Lying on her bed, she gently sniffed the small blanket Li Luo had given her as a child. Ying Chanxi turned to look at the Pikachu doll on her bedside table.

Reaching out, she hugged the Pikachu and gave it a light punch.

But after a moment's thought, she felt a bit embarrassed, so she patted the Pikachu's head and whispered, "I'm sorry."

Afterward, her mood finally brightened. Lying in bed, she hugged the panda doll on her other side and sweetly drifted off to dreamland.

(End of Chapter)
